open_points: Clock: sweep note on FIT-G3 says 30 game minutes is 15 real seconds; at 120 s a game hour it is 60 s. Recomputed as 60.

First hour: at 120 s a game hour the staged landing at play minute 11:30 reads about 20:06, not inside the 22:00 to 01:00 window, even with no talk stops (21:21). It needs a first-evening rate, a later start, or the landing tied to a state, not a minute. Also 'Tuesday at 13:00' reads Monday 20:51 and 'rent due tomorrow' at minute 56 fits neither clock. His decision.

Calendar: seven weeks at 48 min a day is 26.2 to 39.2 running hours against his 15 to 20. At the old played share (0.68) 15 to 20 h fits about 3.9 to 5.2 weeks. The calendar was ruled 7 weeks, Act II 5; not changed here. Three bot playthroughs decide; a decision is owed.
WQ-02 (Act II in stages of at most 4 real hours) now needs seven or more stages in 18.6 to 28 h.
Act II fail-safe, dial and Ellis falls, cooling and buyback keep their game-day counts; their real durations doubled (listed with old values).
Prototype walks 1.85 and runs 4.5 (or 4.2); blueprint G4 walks 1.6 and runs 5.5. Blueprint used; prototype figures still sit in the prototype.
Rain reach factor: rules.js cuts 60 percent, foot.js x0.6. x0.4 chosen.
Knockout: prototype 25 game minutes (50 s on this clock) against blueprint 10 to 30 s. Blueprint kept.
Beat hours: prototype 21 to 5, G5 22 to 06. G5 used. Ellis talk from day 2 (blueprint) against prototype day 4.

Rung 4 fronts: blueprint at least 2; prototype 3. Blueprint used (rise.rung4.fronts is still listed as a working value; use act/rung rows from RT-04: five cars, night desk, one front, one round and the cold-store contract for rung 3).

Car handling: prototype driving numbers (accel 6.2 m/s2, top 14.5 m/s, turn) are arcade values not covered by the M1 to M12 bands; the build follows the bands. Prototype values listed only where a blueprint part uses them.

Owed from footage (value null): firearm hit chance, timings, recoil, rate, reload; crowd avoid radius, step-aside time, look-before-step, spawn distance; sound reach of scuffle, voices, doors, engines; witness report strength by kind; car pull amount.
Traffic arrival gaps are real seconds, but their hour bands are game hours, now 120 s each (the model was written for 30 s hours).
Entries with status 'working' are prototype values the blueprint relies on but does not state; 'ref' entries are held by the economy design.
